query: .tables and .schema over the SQLite file

query: SELECT fld024 FROM tab13; aggregate checks for '+%' and NULL
result: 23657 results, 5961 non-null times. 972 full time strings such as 1:34:50.616; 4989 gap strings beginning with '+' such as +5.478; 17696 NULL. Winners carry the full time, other classified drivers carry '+gap'.

query: SELECT fld041, fld027 FROM tab12; join counts with tab13.fld041 and fld024

query: SELECT MIN(fld026), MAX(fld026) FROM tab06, tab07, tab08; inspect tab13.fld026

query: SELECT d.fld017, d.fld018, d.fld012, MAX(ds.fld031), MAX(ds.fld026) FROM tab08 ds JOIN tab03 d ON d.fld013 = ds.fld013 GROUP BY d.fld013 ORDER BY MAX(ds.fld031) DESC

query: SELECT d.fld017, d.fld018, ds.fld026, ds.fld029, ds.fld031 FROM tab08 ds JOIN tab05 r ON r.fld021 = ds.fld021 JOIN tab04 s ON s.fld020 = r.fld020 JOIN tab03 d ON d.fld013 = ds.fld013 WHERE s.fld020 = 2009 AND ds.fld029 = 1 ORDER BY r.fld022 DESC
